what: A live check of two changes made on 2026-10-08 (a check that cannot finish; one system prompt per request), and the three small probes that found what the second one had missed.
authorisedBy: the founder, 2026-10-08, answering a question that named it: re-run the three hard tasks, Rune (new build) against OpenCode, both gpt-6-sol, 6 agent runs, stop at 70%

build.rune: a clean clone at ddfe410, run from source

stoppedAfter: one pair of three. The wall allowance given was 100 minutes and a serious pair may take 90, so the rig would not start a second. An error in the plan, not in the run; the two tasks left were run afterwards on the fixed build under their own manifest.

rune.verdict: partial: four criteria it stated, two needing review, two unassessed

whatItShowed.a_check_that_cannot_finish: As designed for a first run in a fresh workspace: the suite was waited for once, 120 s, and measured nothing; the three test files the change touched were then run in its place and pass. The notice said both.
whatItShowed.one_system_prompt: The system prompt was 25,617 characters on every call. The second request still read 0 cached tokens and paid for 15,159 fresh. OpenCode's second request: 456 fresh, 12,032 cached. The change did not do what it was predicted to do.
whatItShowed.the_reviewer: Three background screens on gpt-6-astra, 7.5k to 8.5k input tokens each, 5 to 26 output tokens each, $0.076 to $0.085 each: 22% of the run's list cost.
whatItShowed.time: Rune's working time was 440 s against OpenCode's whole run of 380 s; the day before it was 390 s against 425 s. One run each: this is noise the size of the effect being looked for.

probes.what: One small task (read three files in three steps, then answer), gpt-6-sol on Codex, four requests each. Fresh input tokens, then cached, per request.
probes.finding: A request sent at a different reasoning effort from the one before it reads nothing from the Codex prompt cache. Effort routing changed the effort at the second request of every run.

limitations: One pair, one run. No score.
The probes are one task and four requests; they show the mechanism, not its size on real work.
Wall time on this machine: one small test file was run during the pair.
The Codex CLI's own use of the same subscription cannot be seen from here.
